## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A decision card posted by a worker in project A is returned by an inbox...

The system SHALL ensure that a decision card posted by a worker in project A is returned by an inbox query spanning all registered projects.

#### Scenario: A decision card posted by a worker in project A is returned by an inbox...

WHEN `add-the-cross-project-decision-inbox-and-project-index` is implemented
THEN A decision card posted by a worker in project A is returned by an inbox query spanning all registered projects.

### Requirement: Answering the same card twice applies exactly once, proven by a test...

The system SHALL ensure that answering the same card twice applies exactly once, proven by a test asserting a single applied transition.

#### Scenario: Answering the same card twice applies exactly once, proven by a test...

WHEN `add-the-cross-project-decision-inbox-and-project-index` is implemented
THEN Answering the same card twice applies exactly once, proven by a test asserting a single applied transition.

### Requirement: An unanswered card past its deadline resolves to its declared default and is...

The system SHALL ensure that an unanswered card past its deadline resolves to its declared default and is logged as an expiry, not as a human decision.

#### Scenario: An unanswered card past its deadline resolves to its declared default and is...

WHEN `add-the-cross-project-decision-inbox-and-project-index` is implemented
THEN An unanswered card past its deadline resolves to its declared default and is logged as an expiry, not as a human decision.

### Requirement: A single coordinator call returns every registered repository with its...

The system SHALL ensure that a single coordinator call returns every registered repository with its active roadmaps, in-flight items, and open-card count.

#### Scenario: A single coordinator call returns every registered repository with its...

WHEN `add-the-cross-project-decision-inbox-and-project-index` is implemented
THEN A single coordinator call returns every registered repository with its active roadmaps, in-flight items, and open-card count.
